name: dsa-visualizer-suite
description: DSA Algorithm Visualizer Suite — Graph, Sorting, Tree, Pattern

scripts.build: npm run build:pattern && npm run build:tree && npm run build:graph && npm run build:sorting && npm run build:dp && npm run build:binary-search && node copy-dist.js
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix apps/pattern && npm run build --prefix apps/pattern && npm install --prefix apps/tree && npm run build --prefix apps/tree && npm install --prefix apps/graph && npm run build --prefix apps/graph && npm install --prefix apps/sorting && npm run build --prefix apps/sorting && npm install --prefix apps/dp && npm run build --prefix apps/dp && npm install --prefix apps/binary-search && npm run build --prefix apps/binary-search && node copy-dist.js
scripts.build:graph: npm install --prefix apps/graph && npm run build --prefix apps/graph
scripts.build:sorting: npm install --prefix apps/sorting && npm run build --prefix apps/sorting
scripts.build:tree: npm install --prefix apps/tree && npm run build --prefix apps/tree
scripts.build:pattern: npm install --prefix apps/pattern && npm run build --prefix apps/pattern
scripts.build:dp: npm install --prefix apps/dp && npm run build --prefix apps/dp
scripts.build:binary-search: npm install --prefix apps/binary-search && npm run build --prefix apps/binary-search
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/graph && npm install --prefix apps/sorting && npm install --prefix apps/tree && npm install --prefix apps/pattern && npm install --prefix apps/dp && npm install --prefix apps/binary-search
